partial_structures_positive_geometry.name: partial_structures_positive_geometry
partial_structures_positive_geometry.value:
("partial_structures"."length_m" is null or "partial_structures"."length_m" > 0)
        and ("partial_structures"."width_m" is null or "partial_structures"."width_m" > 0)
        and ("partial_structures"."area_sq_m" is null or "partial_structures"."area_sq_m" > 0)
        and ("partial_structures"."clear_height_m" is null or "partial_structures"."clear_height_m" > 0)

components_year_ranges.name: components_year_ranges
components_year_ranges.value:
("components"."construction_year" is null or "components"."construction_year" between 1700 and 2200)
        and ("components"."install_year" is null or "components"."install_year" between 1700 and 2200)

documents_partial_structure_requires_bri.name: documents_partial_structure_requires_bridge
documents_partial_structure_requires_bri.value: "documents"."partial_structure_id" is null or "documents"."bridge_id" is not null

findings_non_negative_measurements.name: findings_non_negative_measurements
findings_non_negative_measurements.value:
("findings"."dimension_length" is null or "findings"."dimension_length" >= 0)
        and ("findings"."dimension_width" is null or "findings"."dimension_width" >= 0)
        and ("findings"."dimension_depth" is null or "findings"."dimension_depth" >= 0)
        and ("findings"."quantity" is null or "findings"."quantity" >= 0)

findings_dimension_unit_pair.name: findings_dimension_unit_pair
findings_dimension_unit_pair.value:
(
        ("findings"."dimension_length" is null and "findings"."dimension_width" is null and "findings"."dimension_depth" is null and "findings"."dimension_unit" is null)
        or
        (("findings"."dimension_length" is not null or "findings"."dimension_width" is not null or "findings"."dimension_depth" is not null)
          and nullif(btrim("findings"."dimension_unit"), '') is not null)
      )

findings_quantity_unit_pair.name: findings_quantity_unit_pair
findings_quantity_unit_pair.value:
("findings"."quantity" is null and "findings"."quantity_unit" is null)
        or ("findings"."quantity" is not null and nullif(btrim("findings"."quantity_unit"), '') is not null)

findings_svd_ranges.name: findings_svd_ranges
findings_svd_ranges.value:
("findings"."stability_rating" is null or "findings"."stability_rating" between 0 and 4)
        and ("findings"."traffic_safety_rating" is null or "findings"."traffic_safety_rating" between 0 and 4)
        and ("findings"."durability_rating" is null or "findings"."durability_rating" between 0 and 4)

historical_works_date_order.name: historical_works_date_order
historical_works_date_order.value: "historical_works"."started_on" is null or "historical_works"."ended_on" is null or "historical_works"."ended_on" >= "historical_works"."started_on"

historical_works_quantity_unit_pair.name: historical_works_quantity_unit_pair
historical_works_quantity_unit_pair.value:
("historical_works"."quantity" is null and "historical_works"."unit" is null)
        or ("historical_works"."quantity" >= 0 and nullif(btrim("historical_works"."unit"), '') is not null)

historical_works_amount_currency_pair.name: historical_works_amount_currency_pair
historical_works_amount_currency_pair.value:
("historical_works"."contract_amount" is null and "historical_works"."final_amount" is null and "historical_works"."currency" is null)
        or (
          ("historical_works"."contract_amount" is not null or "historical_works"."final_amount" is not null)
          and ("historical_works"."contract_amount" is null or "historical_works"."contract_amount" >= 0)
          and ("historical_works"."final_amount" is null or "historical_works"."final_amount" >= 0)
          and "historical_works"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
        )

bridge_evidence_derivation_valid.name: bridge_evidence_derivation_valid
bridge_evidence_derivation_valid.value:
("bridge_evidence"."kind" = 'SOURCE_FACT' and "bridge_evidence"."derivation_method" is null)
        or ("bridge_evidence"."kind" = 'DERIVED' and nullif(btrim("bridge_evidence"."derivation_method"), '') is not null)

component_evidence_derivation_valid.name: component_evidence_derivation_valid

historical_work_evidence_derivation_vali.name: historical_work_evidence_derivation_valid
historical_work_evidence_derivation_vali.value:
("historical_work_evidence"."kind" = 'SOURCE_FACT' and "historical_work_evidence"."derivation_method" is null)
        or ("historical_work_evidence"."kind" = 'DERIVED' and nullif(btrim("historical_work_evidence"."derivation_method"), '') is not null)

inspection_evidence_derivation_valid.name: inspection_evidence_derivation_valid
inspection_evidence_derivation_valid.value:
("inspection_evidence"."kind" = 'SOURCE_FACT' and "inspection_evidence"."derivation_method" is null)
        or ("inspection_evidence"."kind" = 'DERIVED' and nullif(btrim("inspection_evidence"."derivation_method"), '') is not null)

partial_structure_evidence_derivation_va.name: partial_structure_evidence_derivation_valid
partial_structure_evidence_derivation_va.value:
("partial_structure_evidence"."kind" = 'SOURCE_FACT' and "partial_structure_evidence"."derivation_method" is null)
        or ("partial_structure_evidence"."kind" = 'DERIVED' and nullif(btrim("partial_structure_evidence"."derivation_method"), '') is not null)

recommendation_evidence_derivation_valid.name: recommendation_evidence_derivation_valid
recommendation_evidence_derivation_valid.value:
("recommendation_evidence"."kind" = 'SOURCE_FACT' and "recommendation_evidence"."derivation_method" is null)
        or ("recommendation_evidence"."kind" = 'DERIVED' and nullif(btrim("recommendation_evidence"."derivation_method"), '') is not null)

source_evidence_bounding_box_complete.name: source_evidence_bounding_box_complete
source_evidence_bounding_box_complete.value:
(
        "source_evidence"."bounding_box_x" is null and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_y" is null
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_width" is null and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_height" is null
      ) or (
        "source_evidence"."bounding_box_x" is not null and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_y" is not null
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_width" is not null and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_height" is not null
        and "source_evidence"."page_number" is not null
      )

source_evidence_bounding_box_range.name: source_evidence_bounding_box_range
source_evidence_bounding_box_range.value:
"source_evidence"."bounding_box_x" is null or (
        "source_evidence"."bounding_box_x" between 0 and 1
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_y" between 0 and 1
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_width" > 0 and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_width" <= 1
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_height" > 0 and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_height" <= 1
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_x" + "source_evidence"."bounding_box_width" <= 1
        and "source_evidence"."bounding_box_y" + "source_evidence"."bounding_box_height" <= 1
      )

traffic_observation_evidence_derivation_.name: traffic_observation_evidence_derivation_valid
traffic_observation_evidence_derivation_.value:
("traffic_observation_evidence"."kind" = 'SOURCE_FACT' and "traffic_observation_evidence"."derivation_method" is null)
        or ("traffic_observation_evidence"."kind" = 'DERIVED' and nullif(btrim("traffic_observation_evidence"."derivation_method"), '') is not null)

recommendations_quantity_unit_pair.name: recommendations_quantity_unit_pair
recommendations_quantity_unit_pair.value:
("recommendations"."quantity" is null and "recommendations"."unit" is null)
        or ("recommendations"."quantity" >= 0 and nullif(btrim("recommendations"."unit"), '') is not null)

recommendations_estimated_cost_pair.name: recommendations_estimated_cost_pair
recommendations_estimated_cost_pair.value:
("recommendations"."source_estimated_cost" is null and "recommendations"."source_estimated_cost_currency" is null)
        or ("recommendations"."source_estimated_cost" >= 0 and "recommendations"."source_estimated_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

recommendations_year_ranges.name: recommendations_year_ranges
recommendations_year_ranges.value:
("recommendations"."target_year" is null or "recommendations"."target_year" between 1700 and 2200)
        and ("recommendations"."planned_year" is null or "recommendations"."planned_year" between 1700 and 2200)
